svg.title: 4C open-source Harness ladder for interactive coding
svg.desc: Fifteen active open-source coding Harnesses ranked from pinned code evidence. Five source-fit leaders tie at 80. Longer bars mean better fit, not higher price.
svg.text: One terrain · One formula · Exact commits · Source-fit predictions, not runtime claims

g.text: LONGER BAR = MORE VERIFIED OUTPUT PER LIMIT. DOLLAR EFFICIENCY IS BETTER WHEN LONGER.
SCOPE Active general-purpose open-source coding Harnesses with ≥10k GitHub stars
GRADE Source ceiling = 4/5 · Every 3+ requires implementation + executable invariant + reachability + falsifier
BOUNDARY Source-fit prediction only. Paired runtime trials may overturn this order. Equal evidence stays tied.
